BrochureContent.Content: Casey and Kingston are delighted to bring Arden, Shanakiel, Sundays Well to the market. This 5-bed, 5 bath, detached home comprising 2,118 sq.ft. offers a rare opportunity to acquire a property in one of Cork’s most sought-after and established residential locations. Arden offers large private gardens and a spacious driveway unseen with City Centre properties alike. Sundays Well combines peaceful living with the benefit of City Centre convenience, presenting a spacious family home with excellent potential for modernisation to suit one’s own style and specification.

Foyer: 
Bright and welcoming foyer entrance with an abundance of natural light.
Hall:
Spacious entrance hall featuring high ceilings and an elegant mahogany staircase, providing access to all corners of the home.
Living room:
Large south and north-facing living room filled with natural light, extending the full width of the left hand side of the house.
TV Room:
Spacious TV room, ideal as a cosy lounge, home office or a study space.
Sitting / Dining Room:
Generous sitting room with feature fireplace and large sliding doors providing direct access to the garden. Mixture of carpet & tiled floors, perfect for dining room use.
Kitchen:
Well appointed kitchen with floor & eye level hardwood units, laminate flooring, large bay window overlooking the paved driveway.
Guest Bathroom:
Downstairs 2-piece guest bathroom.
Utility:	
Fully fitted utility to the rear of the house. Hardwood units and sink. Provides access to the garden.
Master Bedroom: 
Master bedroom has large south facing window that brings lots of light into the room. Room fits a double bed, and has an un suite. 
Bedroom 2:
Large double bedroom, with carpet floors, built in robes and 3 piece en suite.
Bedroom 3:
South facing double room with carpet floors and built in robes.
Bedroom 4:
Double room overlooking the front of the property with fitted wardrobes and walk in 3 piece en suite.
Bedroom 5:
Double south facing bedroom with built in robes and carpet floors.
Family W/C
Family 3-piece bathroom with bathtub, laminate floors and tiled walls. 
Garden Shed/ Storage:
Large block and mortar built shed to the rear of house. Perfect for storage use.

Large 5 bed family home with paved private driveway and south facing garden.
Detached house, 2-storey home of  2,118 sq.ft.
Spacious and bright home with classic high ceilings.
Great location within Cork City.
Arden offers exceptional potential for buyers to put their own design and mark on this wonderful City Centre property.

The property is situated in the heart of Shanakiel. Sundays Well is a mature and highly regarded residential area known for its quiet surroundings and elevated setting overlooking Cork City. Arden enjoys excellent connectivity, located approximately 3km from Cork City Centre with convenient access to the N20 and major road networks. 
Occupiers in the vicinity of note include; Apple, Bon Secours Hospital, University College Cork, The Kingsley Hotel, Fitzgerald’s Park, Cork University Hospital and many more.
